summary: AWS EC2 inventory source: choose Amazon EC2, an optional AWS credential (omit to use the instance IAM role) and Source variables for aws_ec2; using only include_filters returns all hosts, so put the first condition in filters.
questions: How do I create an AWS EC2 inventory source?
Can controller use an IAM role instead of an AWS credential?
Why does my aws_ec2 inventory return all hosts with include_filters?
How do I override aws_ec2 plugin options?

answer_card.title: aws_ec2 include_filters returns every host
answer_card.answer_md: If you set only `include_filters`, the aws_ec2 plugin returns all hosts. Put the first condition in `filters`, and the other OR conditions in a list under `include_filters`, in the inventory source's *Source variables*.
